title: "Trial"
format: html
---

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Simulate data

```{r}
set.seed(123)

n <- 200
x1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 5, sd = 2)
x2 <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
epsilon <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# True model: y = 2 + 0.5*x1 + 1.2*x2 + error
y <- 2 + 0.5 * x1 + 1.2 * x2 + epsilon

df <- tibble(y, x1, x2)
head(df)
```

## Run regression

```{r}
model <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df)
summary(model)
```

## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = x1, y = y, color = factor(x2))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(color = "x2") +
  theme_minimal()
```
